# Candor - Complete Website Text

## About Candor
Candor is a flat-fee sustainability consulting business based in Vancouver, BC, run entirely by founder Artem Furman. Artem has 4 years of experience managing cannabis retail operations in BC and studies environmental economics at Simon Fraser University. Candor helps local small businesses navigate complex eco-certifications.

## Services & Pricing
1. Readiness Audit ($1,800 CAD): A complete review of a business against sustainability standards, delivered as a written report in 2 to 4 weeks. The client keeps the report forever.
2. Gap-Closing ($6,500 CAD): A 3 to 4 month project where Candor writes the policies and sets up the tracking frameworks a business needs to qualify for certifications.
3. Full Path ($12,000+ CAD): Complete support from start to finish over 9 to 12 months until the business is fully certified.

## Industries Served
Craft cannabis, outdoor gear and apparel, food and beverage, clean beauty, coffee, hospitality, and fitness studios.
